questions.question: What is one way to do your best at a Cub meeting?
options: Join in and listen when others are speaking
Talk while someone else is explaining
Leave whenever an activity is difficult
questions.answer: Join in and listen when others are speaking
questions.explanation: Doing your best includes taking part and showing respect to the Pack.

questions.question: When is it especially important to wash your hands?
options: Before eating and after using the toilet
Only when your hands look dirty
questions.answer: Before eating and after using the toilet
questions.explanation: Washing with soap and water helps remove germs.

questions.question: What does conservation mean?
options: Looking after nature and using resources carefully
Collecting as many things from nature as possible
Making sure nobody visits the outdoors
Using water and electricity without limits
questions.answer: Looking after nature and using resources carefully
questions.explanation: Conservation helps protect nature and the resources people and animals need.

questions.question: On an eight-point compass, which direction lies halfway between north and east?
questions.explanation: North-east is one of the four points between the main compass directions.

questions.question: Which situation could cause someone to trip at home?
options: A toy left on a staircase
questions.answer: A toy left on a staircase
questions.explanation: Keeping walkways and stairs clear can help prevent trips and falls.

questions.question: If someone is hurt in an accident, what should you do first?
options: Get a trusted adult to help straight away
Move the person without asking for help
questions.answer: Get a trusted adult to help straight away
questions.explanation: Tell a trusted adult immediately. If someone is in serious danger, get emergency help with an adult.

questions.question: When you are unsure whether water is safe to drink, what should you do?
options: Ask a trusted adult before drinking it
Drink it only if it is cold
questions.answer: Ask a trusted adult before drinking it
questions.explanation: A trusted adult can help make sure your drinking water is safe.

questions.question: If a campfire spreads beyond its safe area, what should a Cub do?
options: Move away and alert the responsible adult
Try to put it out alone
Run closer to see what happened
questions.answer: Move away and alert the responsible adult
questions.explanation: Move to a safe place and tell the leader or responsible adult straight away.

questions.question: What is a compass useful for when you are outdoors?
options: Measuring how tall a tree is
Telling how deep a river is
questions.explanation: A compass can help you work out which direction you are facing.

questions.question: What is useful to include in a family home safety plan?
options: A safe way to leave and a place to meet outside
A list of favourite television shows
A plan to handle every emergency alone
questions.answer: A safe way to leave and a place to meet outside
questions.explanation: Make a plan with your family and practise it with a responsible adult.

questions.question: You find a bottle marked with a poison warning. What should you do?
options: Leave it alone and tell a trusted adult
Open it to find out what is inside
questions.answer: Leave it alone and tell a trusted adult
questions.explanation: Never touch or taste unknown chemicals. Tell an adult so they can handle it safely.

questions.question: What is a poison?
options: Something that can make you sick, hurt you or kill you
questions.answer: Something that can make you sick, hurt you or kill you

questions.question: Can you tell if something is poisonous just by looking at it?
options: Yes, poisons are always brightly coloured
Yes, poisons always have warning labels
No, poisons can look like food or drinks
Yes, poisonous things always look dangerous
questions.answer: No, poisons can look like food or drinks

questions.question: Can a nice smell tell you that something is safe?
options: Yes, nice smells are always safe
No, some nice-smelling products are poisonous
Yes, if it smells like lemon, it is safe
No, because all poisons smell terrible
questions.answer: No, some nice-smelling products are poisonous

questions.question: You find a liquid in an old cooldrink bottle. What should you do?
options: Ask a friend to try it
Leave it alone and tell an adult
questions.answer: Leave it alone and tell an adult

questions.question: How can a poison get into your body besides through your mouth?
options: Through your skin, eyes or lungs
It cannot get in any other way
questions.answer: Through your skin, eyes or lungs

questions.question: Which of these could be a poison found at home?
What should you do before taking medicine?
options: Take it if the colour looks familiar
Ask a friend if it is the right one
Get an adult to give it to you
Take two to be extra healthy
questions.answer: Get an adult to give it to you

questions.question: Your little brother is holding an open bottle of tablets. What should you do?
options: Find an adult immediately and tell them what happened
Hide the bottle and say nothing
Give him a sweet instead and walk away
questions.answer: Find an adult immediately and tell them what happened

questions.question: Your friend dares you to eat a wild mushroom. What should you do?
options: Eat it if it looks like one from a shop
Ask your friend to taste it first
Do not eat it; wild mushrooms can be poisonous
questions.answer: Do not eat it; wild mushrooms can be poisonous

questions.question: Which nice-smelling product could poison you if you drank it?
Can eating too many vitamins make you sick?
options: Yes, too many can harm you
No, you can eat as many as you like
questions.answer: Yes, too many can harm you

questions.question: Grandma leaves her medicine in her handbag. Your baby sister can reach the bag. What is the safest thing to do?
options: Put the bag somewhere locked or out of her reach
Move the pills into a sweet packet
Tell your sister not to touch it and do nothing else
questions.answer: Put the bag somewhere locked or out of her reach

questions.question: What should you do if cleaning fumes are making you feel unwell?
options: Tell an adult and move away to fresh air if safe
Light a match to remove the smell
questions.answer: Tell an adult and move away to fresh air if safe

questions.question: What does the word "fatal" mean?
Which of these sea animals can sting or bite and inject venom?
Someone gets a poisonous chemical in their eye. What should you do?
options: Tell an adult, rinse the eye with clean running water right away for at least 20 minutes, and get Poison Centre or emergency advice
questions.answer: Tell an adult, rinse the eye with clean running water right away for at least 20 minutes, and get Poison Centre or emergency advice
questions.explanation: Rinse the eye under clean running water for at least 20 minutes, then get Poison Centre or emergency advice. South African Department of Health guidance recommends immediate flushing.

questions.question: Which berries are safest to eat?
options: Unknown berries from a park bush
Berries a friend found in the garden
Berries from a sealed shop-bought food packet
questions.answer: Berries from a sealed shop-bought food packet

questions.question: Is it safe to give your dog medicine made for people?
options: Yes, if you give half a tablet
Yes, if the dog is big
No, human medicines can harm dogs
Yes, if the dog looks sick
questions.answer: No, human medicines can harm dogs

questions.question: Someone may have swallowed poison. What should you do?
options: Give them milk to cancel out the poison
Wait to see if they get sick
Get urgent professional help and follow their instructions
questions.answer: Get urgent professional help and follow their instructions
questions.explanation: Do not try to make the person vomit or give a home remedy. Get urgent professional advice.

questions.question: What is the safest rule for unknown products, plants and berries?
options: Don't touch, don't taste, ask first
Ask a friend to test it
questions.answer: Don't touch, don't taste, ask first
